snippet.title: Hoard Defender VR - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcing Hoard Defender VR! Hoard Defender VR is a casual arcade game set on a volcano top in medieval ages where you play as a dragon! Defend your hoard from the local king as he sends his armies of peasants and knights to steal it! Buy upgrades, defeat enemies, and amass gold! You can wishlist now on Steam!

Hoard Defender VR Steam Store Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603350/Hoard_Defender_VR/

Barnaby's House of Wizardry Discord:
https://discord.gg/xyd92FD2pf

Barnaby's House of Wizardry Bluesky:
https://bsky.app/profile/barnabyshow.bsky.social

Written and recorded by Freddy Martin
